question: Which of the following is the correct chemical formula of sodium aluminate?
solution:
The correct answer is **__NaAlO2__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sodium aluminate is an important marketable inorganic chemical.
 
• It works as an effective source of aluminium hydroxide for numerous artificial and specialized operations.
 
• Pure sodium aluminate( anhydrous) is a white crystalline solid having a formula similarly given as NaAlO2, Na2O · Al2O3, or Na2Al2O4.
